top_events.title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
top_events.label: NATO vows defense against Russian nuclear satellite threat
top_events.summary: Russia reportedly plans to launch a nuclear-armed satellite within weeks, prompting NATO to pledge defensive measures against this new space-based threat to alliance security.

top_events.title: Ukraine confirms it used naval drones to strike two Russian ships off Libya

top_events.summary: Ukrainian security service confirms seven drones launched from mothership sank Russian warship Merkury in Benghazi, extending war operations far beyond Black Sea theater.

short_summary: Ukrainian drone strikes Russian ship Gulf Finland

most_significant_event.label: Ukrainian drone strikes Russian ship Gulf Finland
most_significant_event.summary: A Russian vessel was attacked in the Gulf of Finland, likely by Ukrainian drones. The incident extends the conflict into the Baltic Sea region, closer to Poland's maritime borders.
